selected_image_concept.title_ja: 楽園の森の探検：豊かな嗅覚と感覚の発見
selected_image_concept.title_en: Island Jungle Explorer: A World of Rich Senses
selected_image_concept.concept_ja: 探検家アヒルがドードー鳥と一緒に熱帯の豊かな森を歩き、ドードーが持つ鋭い嗅覚と豊かな感覚世界を体験する自然描写です。
selected_image_concept.concept_en: An explorer duck walking beside a friendly dodo bird through a sunlit tropical forest, following glowing trails of scents and sounds.
selected_image_concept.composition_ja: 陽の光が差し込む美しい森。探検帽をかぶった黄色いアヒルが虫眼鏡を手に、可愛らしいドードー鳥と並んで歩いています。空気中にはドードーの優れた感覚を象徴する光る香りの帯やキラキラした星が漂っています。
selected_image_concept.composition_en: A vibrant sunlit tropical forest. A friendly yellow duck wearing a miniature brown pith helmet holds a gold magnifying glass, walking cheerfully next to a friendly, stylized dodo bird. Glowing scent swirls and floating sparkles wind through exotic flowers around them.
selected_image_concept.generation_prompt_en: Charming modern editorial illustration. The Daily Duck mascot, a cute bright yellow duck with an orange beak, glossy dark eyes, a feather tuft on its head, wearing a small beige safari explorer hat. The duck is walking through a sun-dappled tropical forest beside a stylized, friendly dodo bird with soft brown feathers and an expressive curved beak. Golden sunbeams filter through green foliage, while luminous pastel scent trails and sparkling star dust drift around fragrant tropical flowers, visually representing the dodo's heightened sensory awareness. Bright, joyful atmosphere, soft focus background, visually compelling 3D digital art. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
selected_image_concept.alt_ja: 陽の光が注ぐ熱帯の森で、探検帽をかぶったアヒルとドードー鳥が光る香りの軌跡に囲まれながら歩いているイラスト。
selected_image_concept.alt_en: Illustration of a duck mascot in an explorer hat walking alongside a dodo bird through a tropical forest surrounded by glowing scent trails.

story.title: The dodo bird had a secret sensory world scientists are only now discovering
story.reason: Overturns old misconceptions about the dodo, revealing a clever and sensory-rich creature that charms the imagination.
story.title_ja: ドードー鳥の知られざる感覚の世界：旧来のイメージを覆す発見
story.reason_ja: おっとりしたイメージだったドードー鳥が、実は豊かな感覚を持つ賢い鳥だったことが分かり、昔の誤解を解く微笑ましいニュースです。
story.jp_copy: これまでのイメージとは異なり、絶滅したドードー鳥が実は豊かな感覚世界と知性を持っていたことが最新の研究で判明しました。長年の誤解が解け、ドードー鳥の賢く魅力的な素顔が明らかになる、知的好奇心に満ちた嬉しい発見です。
story.en_copy: Long misunderstood, the dodo bird is now being revealed as a clever creature with a rich sensory world. Scientists are overturning old misconceptions, giving us a fresh and charming perspective on a smart bird whose true nature is finally being appreciated.
story.duck_jp: ドードー鳥は実はとっても賢かったんですね！誤解が解けて良かった！
story.duck_en: The dodo was clever all along! Glad history is setting the record straight.
story.x_jp: 鈍感だと思われていたドードー鳥の秘密が解明！実は豊かな感覚と知性を持った賢い鳥だったことが分かりました。
story.x_en: New discoveries show the dodo bird was actually clever and sensory-rich, overturning old misconceptions!
